page_title: GET 2-0 ALA | Getafe v Alaves 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz de Mera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
90+3' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

90+2' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) tests the keeper with a good header towards the roof of the net from the cross, but Antonio Sivera is up to the task and easily makes the save. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' Flag up against Stoichkov (Alaves). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Mauro Arambarri is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Nabil Aberdin (Getafe).
89' Substitution. Christantus Uche makes his way off the pitch and Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
88' Alaves couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as David Soria (Getafe) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
88' The foul by Christantus Uche (Getafe) was seen by Isidro Diaz de Mera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Alaves have a free kick.
87' Christantus Uche (Getafe) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
87' Alaves concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Getafe win a free kick.
84' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
81' Kike Garcia (Alaves) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
78' It must be a yellow card. It is. Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

77' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
77' It will be a corner kick for Getafe.

77' Carles Perez (Getafe) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. Getafe will take a corner kick.
74' Bertug Yildirim will be replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
73' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Antonio Sivera.
71' Luis Milla (Getafe) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
70' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Alex Sola will be replaced by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonio Blanco (Alaves) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' It is time for a substitution. Asier Villalibre (Alaves) is on for Toni Martinez.
69' Stoichkov (Alaves) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
67' The game has begun to heat up. Alex Sola (Getafe) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.

67' Alex Sola (Getafe) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for an infringement. Alaves will take a free kick near the side line.
65' A pass by Alex Sola (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
64' The attendance for today's match is 10006.
62' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
58' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Luis Milla (Getafe) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Antonio Sivera no chance!
58' Luis Milla (Getafe) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Getafe!
57' There's a break in play and referee Isidro Diaz de Mera must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Getafe using VAR. This could be interesting!
57' Surely that's handball by one of the Alaves players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
56' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Diego Rico (Getafe), who plants a header just wide of the left post from close range.

56' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Isidro Diaz de Mera with no other option than to blow for a foul. Free kick. Getafe will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
55' Substitution. Manu Sanchez (Alaves) replaces Abdel Abqar.
55' Substitution. Santiago Mourino (Alaves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Aleksandar Sedlar walks off.
55' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Carlos Benavidez and he is replaced by Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
50' Alex Sola (Getafe) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
48' Getafe are ruled offside.
48' A rebound falls kindly for Joan Jordan (Alaves), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
47' Djene (Getafe) makes a slide tackle, but referee Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Alaves.
46' Today's match ends for Toni Martinez who will be replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' The match has reached half-time.
45+9' The Alaves players are stunned as referee Isidro Diaz de Mera changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
45+8' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Alaves using VAR. Let's see what happens.
45+7' Handball! A player from Getafe handled the ball. It's a penalty! Alaves have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
45+6' A corner kick by Alaves is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).
45+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
45+2' Luis Garcia Plaza isn't happy on the touchline after referee Isidro Diaz de Mera shows him a yellow card.
45' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Getafe have been awarded a free kick.

42' 1 - 0 Goal! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) takes the resulting free-kick from the edge of the box, but the ball takes a deflection off a defender and goes past the helpless Antonio Sivera and into the net. 1:0.
42' Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera sees the trip by Stoichkov (Alaves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Getafe.

40' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. It's a free kick to Alaves, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
39' Luis Milla (Getafe) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
38' Joan Jordan (Alaves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe earn a free kick.
38' Christantus Uche (Getafe) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
36' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

33' Diego Rico (Getafe) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
31' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Abdel Abqar (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
31' Poor challenge! Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is penalised for tripping and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle. Getafe win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
27' The free kick is delivered by Luis Milla (Getafe) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
26' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Getafe in a dangerous position.

25' Christantus Uche (Getafe) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
23' The linesman signals that Christantus Uche (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

22' Excellent touch by Christantus Uche (Getafe)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
21' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Joan Jordan (Alaves). Getafe are awarded the free kick.
20' The free kick is taken by Carles Perez (Getafe), but ball is cleared.

19' The game is interrupted. Carlos Martin (Alaves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Getafe have a free kick.

18' Stoichkov (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz de Mera no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
17' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
15' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' Surely that's handball by one of the Alaves players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
14' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
13' Stoichkov (Alaves) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Alaves have a corner.
12' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
11' Looks like Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
10' Carles Perez (Getafe) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Alaves have a free kick.
9' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
9' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play. Getafe will take a free kick.
7' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
6' The ball rebounds to Joan Jordan (Alaves) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the right post.
4' Diego Rico (Getafe) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Alaves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Isidro Diaz de Mera.
